blocks.x: A working definition of Identity & Access Modernization for the enterprise: engineered controls, named owners, weekly evidence, and a signed baseline so every claim of improvement can be replayed line by line.
This page covers Identity & Access Modernization the way we deliver it: the pattern, the stack it runs on, the guards we ship and the artifacts your team holds at the first quarter close.

blocks.title: Zero-trust verification mesh — Identity & Access Modernization
blocks.note: Lateral movement dies here: workload identity and micro-segmentation mean one compromised node is one node, not the estate.

blocks.x: The architecture for Identity & Access Modernization is deliberately auditable: every stage exposes its inputs, its owner and its failure policy, and the decision path shares a timeline with the audit path. Nothing important happens off the record.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Identity & Access Modernization capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.

blocks.title: Delivery cadence — Identity & Access Modernization
blocks.note: The fortnightly reading and the quarterly re-audit are the loop's heartbeat — the program cannot drift far between two beats.
